name: Lemon Beebalm

facts.how: Fresh or dried as tea and seasoning

caution: A well-known safe mint-family herb; simply confirm the square stem and minty aroma. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Whorls of pink-lavender flowers stack up the square stem, and the crushed leaves smell of citrus, oregano, and thyme.

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: A bright herbal tea and a fine wild seasoning for beans and meat; the flowers are edible too.
